definitions.face: Start with chin-to-inner-brow affine Y and head-to-nose affine Z; expand outward to include every point of the clipped g050 surface patch mapped through shared vertex IDs and barycentric coordinates. Preserve exact g050 bounds.
definitions.neck: Reference g050 vertices with >=1% combined neck/clavicle skin weight below the chin landmark; target triangles with any corresponding vertex, including all their corners. AABB encloses the actual target patch. Pose its vertex IDs each frame before constructing runtime bounds.

limits: Bounds are anatomical measurement regions, not collision envelopes or a visibility guarantee.
Existing g050 face/head boxes deliberately cover only part of the head; crown and rear contacts require a separate whole-body/whole-head report.

Body vertex/UV/skin correspondence is verified. Triangulation varies elsewhere, but every face/head reference-patch triangle and neck target-patch triangle is present in both reference and target; these mapped patches use actual target triangles.
Neck/shoulder patch includes upper chest and lower-face overlap at its border; report as a conservative named patch, not exact semantic segmentation.
Static neck bounds in head coordinates must not be reused through a moving-head pose: use the same frame posed body patch positions or report all body crossings.
No portrait or shipping asset changed.
runtimeWeightDerivation: Three r185 GLTFLoader calls SkinnedMesh.normalizeSkinWeights; public method applied to authored Float32 weights before hashing. Source weightFloat32 remains separately pinned.
